name: hcapp_setEventAttendence
description: Records or updates one hasher's attendance at an event (AttendenceState 0-40: <20 not at the run, 20-29 on trail, 30+ On Inn). The hasher is resolved three ways: @hasherId (NULL = the caller), a QR scan (@qrScanText → HC.Hasher.QR_code, in which case @eventId may be the PublicEventId and is resolved to Event.id), or @hemId (the row itself, for visitor/virgin rows whose UserId is the KennelId; its EventId must match @eventId — 1224/12). A hasher marked attended (>= 20) cannot be set back below 20 while a non-cancelled HC.Payment exists on the row (1524/5). Writes the HasherEventMap row (update, or insert with RsvpState 3), keeps HC.Event.Hares in step when @isHare is given (rebuilt only where the text is this SP's own; admin-typed text only ever gains a name), recalculates the hasher's run counts when attendance crosses 20, returns adHocData in one of two shapes (manual vs scan) and delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData (@returnUserRecords 0) or hcapp_syncUserData (1). Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 24, @param NULL). Permission gate: self-attendance needs nothing; attendance for another hasher needs HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageAttendance' in the event's kennel, satisfied also by being a hare of this event (1324/13 otherwise). Since 2026-10-13 a newly inserted HasherEventMap row takes IsHare from @isHare (NULL -> 0).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID, passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against the device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event. In scan mode (@qrScanText given) it may be the Event.PublicEventId and is resolved to Event.id (line 142); in manual mode it must be Event.id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher. NULL without @qrScanText = the caller; ignored and replaced by the QR lookup when @qrScanText is given; replaced by the row's UserId when @hemId is given. No SQL default — the client must send it (NULL is fine).

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: New state, 0-40; NULL or out of range is refused with 1224/12. No SQL default.

parameters.name: isHare
parameters.description: Default NULL = leave IsHare alone; -1 is normalised to NULL. 1 marks the hare, 0 clears. Only written on the >= 20 update path (line 297); a NEW row is always inserted with IsHare 0 (line 312). Any non-NULL value triggers the Event.Hares maintenance.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to the delegated sync SP; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to the delegated sync SP; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: returnUserRecords
parameters.description: Default 0 = delegate to hcapp_syncEventAdminData; anything else = hcapp_syncUserData (NULL also takes the user-data path, because NULL = 0 is not true).

parameters.name: qrScanText
parameters.description: QR code text from the scanned hasher's app. When not NULL the SP is in scan mode: @hasherId comes from HC.Hasher.QR_code (1324/13 'Unknown user' if no match), @eventId may be a PublicEventId, and rowset 1 takes the richer scan shape. No SQL default — the client must send it (NULL for manual mode).
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(250) is wider than Hasher.QR_code NVARCHAR(50); harmless for a lookup (a longer value simply matches nothing). The HC5 parameter was NVARCHAR(50).

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Default NULL. When given, the row is addressed directly (visitor/virgin rows) and @hasherId is taken from it; the row's EventId must equal @eventId (1224/12). An id with no row is not detected — the mismatch test is UNKNOWN and the SP carries on using the passed @hasherId.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always the first rowset, on every path including auth failure. success = 1 with NULL codes on success.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. ValidateAppAuth code; 1224 validation; 1324 unknown user / not authorised; 1524 payment registered; 1924 unhandled.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1/3/7 from ValidateAppAuth; 12 validation (state out of range, hemId/eventId mismatch); 13 QR not recognised or not authorised; 5 payment blocks un-attend; 19 unhandled (CATCH).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 when success = 0. All paths log to HC.ErrorLog except the payment guard (1524), whose errorId is a fresh NEWID() that exists nowhere.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog id, or an unlogged NEWID() for 1524.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing message; the payment-guard message names the hasher.

rowsets.name: AdHocNonScanResult
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success when @qrScanText IS NULL (lines 422-429).

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: 'You are' / '<name> is' [already] 'recorded as on the Hash trail at "<event>"' | 'On Inn' | 'not at the run', plus a pay reminder or 'and paid' when the run has a price.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: HasherEventMap.id written (new or existing). Not lowercased — the app's lowerGuidsInPlace handles it.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: Re-read from the row by EventId + UserId after the write.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalRunsThisKennel after the recompute — includes this run once it starts within 6 hours (or has started). NULL until counted.

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalHaringThisKennel after the recompute, same mechanism.

rowsets.name: AdHocScanResult
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success when @qrScanText IS NOT NULL (lines 433-455): the richer shape the check-in scanner shows. The message column is 'userMessage' here, not 'serverMessage'.

columns.name: userMessage
columns.description: Same text as serverMessage in the manual shape.

columns.name: isPaid
columns.description: COUNT of non-cancelled HC.Payment rows on the HEM row (taken BEFORE the write); 0 = unpaid.

columns.name: isMember
columns.description: 1 when HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate > now, else 0 (also 0 with no HKM row).

columns.name: currentPackRunCount
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.CurrentPackRunCount, -1 with no HKM row. Zeroed by the recompute — use totalRunsThisKennel for display.

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: HEM.RsvpState (always present on this path; -1 fallback is unreachable).

columns.name: hares
columns.description: HC.Event.Hares after any rebuild, '' when NULL.

rowsets.name: SyncRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ on success: hcapp_syncEventAdminData (@returnUserRecords = 0; HEM/HKM watermarks passed through, everything else 'ignore') or hcapp_syncUserData (otherwise; @usePaging 0). See those contracts.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState, updatedAt (state < 20, lines 285-288) or AttendenceState, RsvpState = 3, IsHare = COALESCE(@isHare, IsHare), updatedAt (state >= 20, lines 294-299) WHERE id = @hemId.
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap (RsvpState 3, IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0, KennelId from HC.Event) when the hasher has no row on the event (lines 307-312).

UPDATE HC.Event SET Hares, updatedAt when @isHare IS NOT NULL (lines 322-343): rebuilt from flagged hares (IsHare = 1 AND RsvpState = 3) only when the current text is empty or equals that aggregate as it stood before the change; admin-typed text is never replaced and gains a newly flagged hare's DisplayName if absent (1.1.0, 2026-09-28).

EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser @userId = @hasherId after COMMIT, outside the TRY (line 366), when attendance crossed 20 in either direction or a row was inserted. The recompute counts a run once it starts within 6 hours, so a check-in updates run/haring counts in real time.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on validation, unknown-user, not-authorised and CATCH paths (HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId)). NOT on the payment guard.
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData or HC6.hcapp_syncUserData after the adHocData rowset (lines 464-492).

codeSmells.issue: Two incompatible adHocData shapes for the same result
codeSmells.detail: Lines 422-429 name the message column serverMessage; lines 433-455 name it userMessage and add eleven columns. The client has to know which mode it called in to read rowset 1. Carried forward from HC5; unify the name at least.

These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @eventId. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: PublicEventId resolution only in scan mode
codeSmells.detail: Lines 140-144 translate a PublicEventId to Event.id only when @qrScanText is given. A manual call with a PublicEventId finds no HEM row and inserts a row against an id that is not an Event.id (the FK then fails → 1924), or, with @hemId, fails the mismatch test.

codeSmells.issue: Re-reads by EventId + UserId are ambiguous for visitor rows
codeSmells.detail: Lines 368-369 re-read AttendenceState by EventId + UserId although the write at 283-315 was by @hemId. Visitor/virgin rows share the KennelId as UserId, so on an event with several such rows the value echoed in rowset 1 may come from a different row than the one written.

codeSmells.issue: Payment guard does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 209-218 return errorCode 1524 with a NEWID() errorId that is never inserted into HC.ErrorLog; every other refusal in the SP logs. An errorId that resolves to nothing misleads a log review.

Line 381 declares @eventPrice SMALLMONEY while Event.EventPriceForMembers / Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForMembers are DECIMAL(10,4). Only used for a != 0 test, so no loss today; the house type is DECIMAL(10,4).

breakingChanges: @qrScanText widened from NVARCHAR(50) to NVARCHAR(250). Existing callers passing strings <= 50 chars are unaffected (Hasher.QR_code itself is still NVARCHAR(50)).
TRY/CATCH transaction added — HC5 had no error handling or transaction boundary. The write is now atomic; partial updates on SQL error no longer occur.
Success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 (success INT, errorCode INT, errorType INT). HC5 callers reading rowset 0 as the ad-hoc result will now read the envelope instead.
Ad-hoc result is now rowset 1 (not rowset 0). Callers must advance one rowset to read the ad-hoc data.
HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser is now called after the transaction commit (outside TRY/CATCH). In HC5 it was called without a transaction at all.
Delegation targets updated to HC6 SPs (HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData, HC6.hcapp_syncUserData) — HC5 called the HC5 equivalents.
Auth model changed from HC5 shared-secret pattern to HC6 ValidateAppAuth helper SP.
Permission gate for setting another hasher's attendance moved to HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageAttendance' (hare of the event also allowed) — refused with 1324/13.
